summary: Doc 47 (Guidance Runtime Engine) + Doc 48 (Pro-Connect Engine) end-to-end tested. Backend: 27/28 pytest tests passed. 1 test failure was a bad TEST expectation, not a code bug — the balloon_dog inflate step has confidenceRequired=0.7, so confidence=0.65 correctly classifies as 'lost' (not 'candidate'). Behavior is spec-correct (candidate range = [need, 0.85), acquired at >=0.85). Frontend: full UI walkthrough for demo_home@diyhomie.com — guide library shows 3 procedure cards + resume/open-sessions banner, guide-assist-link opens Assistance & Saved screen with My Requests + Saved Demos tabs, balloon_dog player renders step 1 'Inflate the balloon to the marked length' with Fine-Motor mode badge, HAND INFLATE DEMONSTRATION visual composer, voice row, all step controls (show_again, slow_down, another_angle, why, what_tool, im_stuck), Watch a Pro button opens drawer, verify-yes advances to Step 2/10, Bring in a Pro modal generates brief with completed/remaining/tools/materials and successfully submits Quick Question request that appears on the Assist screen. Scope splitter classifies all 11 toilet steps into DIY/PRO chips (Close Shutoff, Lift Toilet, Tighten Bolts, Leak Check flagged as Pro Recommended by safety_engine), help_specific_parts selection toggles chips, Update Project Plan saves. Welcome-back banner appears on procedure re-open: 'Welcome back. We completed "Inflate the balloon to the marked length". Next, we are working on: tie off the nozzle.' Admin request status flow (submitted→matched→in_progress→completed) works. Analytics-safe (no crashes with keyless analytics fallback). Demos clip_url are mock:// as declared. Overall system quality: HIGH.

issues: Minor: TTS autoplay is blocked by browser autoplay policy on web ('play() failed because the user didn\'t interact...') — this is expected browser behavior; TTS works after user gesture. Not a functional bug.
